name: Cacls (SA)
help: Lists file or directory DACL permissions, with wildcard support.
long_help: Displays Access Control List (ACL) entries for files and directories. Shows each ACE with the trustee (domain\user or SID), inheritance flags (CI=Container Inherit, OI=Object Inherit, IO=Inherit Only), and access rights (Full, Read, Write, Change, or specific permissions). Supports wildcards (e.g., C:\Windows\*.exe) to list permissions for multiple files.

arguments.name: filepath
arguments.desc: File or directory path to list permissions for. Supports wildcards (e.g., C:\Windows\*.dll).
